profiles.name: Dzulkefly Ahmad
profiles.description: Dzulkefly Ahmad is Minister of Health. He represents Kuala Selangor, Selangor, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of Parti Amanah Negara (AMANAH).

profiles.name: Amir Hamzah Azizan
profiles.description: Amir Hamzah Azizan is Minister of Finance II. He serves as a senator appointed by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong.
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament lists PROFESIONAL. No political-party membership is inferred; the profile is attached directly to the government bloc.

milestones.title: Equip all public hospitals and primary health facilities with EMR by 2029
milestones.description: Dzulkefly set a 2029 target covering 150 public hospitals and more than 3,000 primary health facilities through hospital and clinic digital-record systems.
milestones.progress_note: The initial statement records existing clinic deployment. His August 2026 update describes accelerated expansion supported by additional funding. Funding is not proof of universal coverage; no comparable completed-facility total for the entire hospital-and-clinic scope was verified.

milestones.title: Reduce the fiscal deficit below 3% of GDP within two years
milestones.description: Amir Hamzah said Malaysia aimed to reduce its fiscal deficit below 3% of GDP within two years through fiscal consolidation and subsidy reforms.
milestones.progress_note: The October statement reports a 3.7% deficit for 2025 and continuing reforms. That GDP ratio is not a completion score. A result for the two-year horizon was not established; no exact day is imposed on the stated horizon.

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.
